verdict.rationale: Mastra documents that developers can build MCP servers with the framework that any MCP-compatible system can reach. This covers exposing custom code over MCP without hand-writing the protocol. Mastra also deploys its server to Mastra Cloud or built-in deployers, but those docs refer to agents and workflows, not explicitly to MCP servers. Nothing in the evidence shows OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion. missing for 10: generating an MCP server from an OpenAPI definition, explicit hosted MCP server deployment, detailed docs on how custom tools are exposed as MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing

citations.quote: MCP servers built with Mastra can be accessed by any system or agent that supports the protocol.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Mastra includes optional built-in deployers for Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare to automate the deployment process.
